changelog: New voice command "select last paragraph" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ অনুচ্ছেদ সিলেক্ট করো" in Bengali) and the paragraph right before the cursor is selected, so you can copy just that paragraph or dictate the correction straight over a whole misheard paragraph. It is the paragraph-sized twin of v14.7's "select last sentence". The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 49 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
